title: Don’t waste your time
body: A lot of ads. Each ad last for 20 seconds to only watch 10 seconds of an episode. You only get 5 episodes to watch , each with a 20 seconds ad to unlock, then have to wait 24 hours to gain to watch another 10 seconds of episode. With more ads. Only way to watch them is to pay a subscription of 18 bucks a week. Not worth it. Go watch regular Netflix or Disney . This app is a scam.
